sections.heading: About the programme

In an era where the healthcare ecosystem is evolving through technological disruption, policy reforms, and rising global integration, this programme empowers participants to think strategically, lead effectively, and manage complexity with confidence. members.name: Prof. Munish Thakur
bio: Dr. Thakur is currently the Dean (Academics) of XLRI Delhi-NCR Campus. He is part of the Strategic Management Area at XLRI and holds expertise in several domains, including Strategic Thinking, Business Policy, and Corporate Governance. His teaching and research interests focus on strategic management, organisational theory, and decision-making processes. With both academic and professional experience, Dr. Thakur plays a significant role in bridging theory with practice, offering valuable insights to his students and contributing to thought leadership in management education. His profile reflects a commitment to fostering analytical and leadership skills through rigorous academic practices.

members.name: Dr. Santosh Sangem
bio: Dr. Santosh Sangem has been associated with XLRI Jamshedpur for the last 15 years. He has provided corporate training and consultancy for reputed organizations in both the private sector and the public sector which include L&T, Viacom18, Pepsi, Meril Life, Accenture, Ultratech, Adani Airports, HDFC Bank, Capgemini, NTPC, ONGC, IOCL, and many other highly reputed organizations. His primary teaching and training and research interests include Corporate Governance, Business Model Design, Healthcare Financial Decision Making, Financial Performance Analysis & Management, Management Control Systems, Decision Thinking & Decision Making, and Corporate Finance. He is currently the Chairperson of the XLRI Center for Healthcare Management and the Chairperson of International Relations & Collaborations at XLRI.

members.name: Dr. Rajeev Sharma
bio: Dr. Sharma is an accomplished business leader with extensive experience in strategy, innovation, and digital transformation. Dr. Rajeev is known for building high-performance teams and delivering sustainable business solutions, leveraging his expertise in strategic planning and change management.

sections.heading: Program Overview
paragraphs: The healthcare industry is undergoing a rapid evolution driven by digital transformation, the pandemic, demographic changes, and rising patient expectations. To navigate this complex landscape, it’s imperative for healthcare professionals, startups, and entrepreneurs to stay abreast of emerging trends and distinguish between viable solutions and mere ideas.

Technology is revolutionizing healthcare, from diagnosis and treatment to patient communication. Electronic records, health tracking apps, and telemedicine are enhancing clinical outcomes, reducing errors; all while improving accessibility.

The global healthcare IT market, valued at USD 760 billion in 2024, is projected to soar to USD 3.4 trillion by 2034, driven by digital advancements and data-driven healthcare. With a CAGR of 15.83%, the sector is set to transform patient care and medical innovation worldwide. Hospitals and healthcare organizations that embrace technology are experiencing improved patient outcomes, reduced costs, and enhanced staff efficiency.

By understanding and effectively implementing digital business models and transformation strategies, healthcare organizations can fully utilize technology to deliver innovative, patient-centered care while achieving sustainable growth.

sections.heading: Course Details
paragraphs: The Strategic HR Leadership program teaches participants how to align HR strategies with the overall goals and objectives of the organization, and addresses the challenges faced in today’s business landscape.

It covers leadership and strategic management skills, managing a diverse workforce that includes multiple generations, gig workers, contractual and remote workers, and quiet quitters, and addresses employee wellness and mental well-being, diversity and inclusivity, and the future of industrial relations and labour laws. It also emphasizes the impact of digitalization on HRM, including how to use technology to enhance HR processes and improve efficiency.
The program aims to build experts in these critical areas which lead to the success of modern-era HR professionals and the organizations they serve.

members.name: Dr. Ankit
bio: Dr. Ankit is an Assistant Professor at XLRI Delhi-NCR. He holds a PhD from IIM Lucknow and is an expert in the field of organizational behaviour. He has multiple journal publications to his name and is a prominent name at global HR conferences.

members.name: Dr. Faisal Ahsan
bio: Dr. Faisal Ahsan holds an FPM/Ph.D. from IIM Lucknow, an M.Tech from IIT Delhi, and a B.Tech from AMU, Aligarh. Currently an Assistant Professor at XLRI Delhi-NCR, he previously taught at IIM Ranchi. With over a decade at TATA Motors, he combines academic excellence with extensive industry experience.

members.name: Dr. Keith C. D'Souza
bio: Currently, Visiting Professor of Organizational Behaviour & Human Resources - S.P. Jain Institute of Management Studies and Research and XLRI Delhi Centre, and Director, Keith D'Souza & Associates HR and OD Services, Mumbai.

members.name: Dr. Snigdha Pattnaik
bio: Dr. Pattnaik has been Pro Vice Chancellor at Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University. She has also served as Professor in HRM and Founding Dean of the School of HRM at XIM University, Bhubaneswar. She is a visiting faculty at the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad and at the Universidad Loyola Andalucia, Seville, Spain.

members.name: Prof. Vinit Thakur
bio: Teacher, trainer & consultant, Prof. Vinit is a certified Psychometric Analyst with over 20+ years of domain experience in project management, banking & trade organizations. A prominent consultant for 3M India, SAP, GE, Ernst & Young and other blue-chip firms.
